data.name: Grimonia
data.gender_notes: Grimonia is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Grimonia was a warrior goddess revered for her strength, courage, and battle skills. Her name derives from the Greek word 'graphein,' meaning 'to write,' and 'onia,' meaning 'man or woman.' This name pays homage to the fierce, independent women of mythology and history. The name Grimonia carries the meaning “Strong, fierce, and skilled woman” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Grimonia usually hope their child will grow to embody strong, fierce, and skilled woman and live with faith, good character and purpose.
